A-26 Agent (seller) users

Bangla name: এজেন্ট (সেলার) ইউজার

← 10 · Admin portal · Contents · Open queries

1. Name and purpose

Agent users. Agents are offline sellers (companies and branches) who sell tickets outside the website. Their accounts live in the Agent Cognito pool. Admins create and manage them here ("Seller Agents"). The pool and the only agent API are described in X-13: POST /ticketing/api/v1/offline-sold-ticket (policy Agent). The client that would use this account is not in the repositories ([UNCONFIRMED: Q-07]).

2. Trigger and actor

Staff in the global menu (Users → Seller Agents, /agent-user, program 0). The server controller AgentController has no [Authorize] at all (X-18).

3. Business flow

List agents (name, phone, e-mail, company, branch, branch location, status); create an agent with name, phone, optional e-mail, company name, company branch and branch location (all required but e-mail); enable, disable, set a new password; the list screen offers no edit and no delete in the portal service.

4. Technical flow

  1. [HTTP + user token] GET /admin/api/v1/agent-users, POST .../agent-users, POST .../agent-users/enable/{userId}, .../disable/{userId}, POST .../agent-users/set-password?userId= (portal agent-user.service.ts). The backend also exposes GET .../{id}, PUT .../{id} (name only) and DELETE .../{id}.
  2. AgentUserManager.CreateUserAsync validates: request present; Name, Phone, CompanyBranch, BranchLocation, CompanyName not empty ("Name should not be empty", "Phone should not be empty", "Agent branch should not be empty", "Branch location should not be empty", "Agent name should not be empty"); then AgentUserProvider.CreateUserAsync: AdminCreateUser in the Agent pool (phone as user name, company attributes), a generated password and the SMS (X-05, X-22).
  3. Disable, enable, set password, delete call the provider (Cognito AdminDisableUser, AdminEnableUser, AdminSetUserPassword, AdminDeleteUser).

5. Components

Kind Component
Client features/agent-user/*, services/agent-user.service.ts:19-35
Service Admin (AgentController, AgentUserManager, AgentUserProvider)
AWS Cognito Agent pool; static AWS keys
External Notification service (SMS)

6. API contracts

Method Path Auth Request Response Main errors
GET /admin/api/v1/agent-users, /{id} none AgentUserResponse
POST /admin/api/v1/agent-users none AgentCreateUser AgentUserResponse 400 messages above
PUT /admin/api/v1/agent-users/{id} none AgentUpdateUser {userId, name} AgentUserResponse
DELETE /admin/api/v1/agent-users/{id} none path bool
POST /admin/api/v1/agent-users/disable/{id}, enable/{id}, set-password?userId= none path / query bool

Primary sample, POST /admin/api/v1/agent-users (names from AgentCreateUser; values illustrative):

{ "name": "Sabbir Hossain", "phone": "+8801700000066", "email": null,
  "companyName": "Ticket Express", "companyBranch": "Dhanmondi", "branchLocation": "Road 8, Dhanmondi, Dhaka" }

Response AgentUserResponse: userId, name, email, phone, companyName, companyBranch, branchLocation, currentStatus, isActive.

7. Data and side effects

A Cognito user in the Agent pool and an SMS; no database row, no activity-log entry.

9. Handover notes

  1. Anyone who can reach the endpoint can create, enable, disable, reset the password of or delete an agent account, and receive no token check. Because the new password is sent by SMS to the phone given in the request, an attacker who creates an account with their own phone obtains working Agent credentials (X-13, X-18).
  2. Agent credentials can then call offline-sold-ticket, which creates tickets without payment.
  3. No audit trail: agent changes are not logged by IActivityLogger (only admin users are, A-25).
  4. No consumer was found for these accounts in the repositories: no agent app, no web client; the OfflineSoldTickets data has no reader either (X-13 [UNCONFIRMED: Q-07]).
  5. set-password takes the user id as a query string.

10. Component relationships

sequenceDiagram participant A as Admin portal (Seller Agents) participant AD as Admin API (no auth) participant CG as Cognito (Agent pool) participant N as Notification service A->>AD: POST /agent-users AD->>CG: AdminCreateUser + password AD->>N: SMS Note over CG: Agent token -> POST ticketing offline-sold-ticket (policy Agent)

Depends on: X-05. Affects: X-13.
